steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ rather than creating or searching for another event.
Enable the required eRFX project capability before navigating.
Open Recreate Order from the stage Settings menu.
Verify that the Recreate Order pop-up opened.
Confirm the recreation dialog contains the expected Product Sheet section.
Confirm the recreation dialog contains auction configuration controls.
Confirm the recreation dialog contains delivery-date controls.
Verify that the requested 60-minute duration is offered.
Select the requested event end-time duration.
Verify that the duration field shows the selected 60-minute value.
Create the recreated event using the configured duration.
Verify that the recreated event retains the prepared event's line-item quantity.
Verify that the recreated event retains the prepared event's line-item unit.
Confirm that the newly opened live event displays its bidding end-time information.
